id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e0: Welcome! Heliodor is a lovely place, isn't it? Do make yourself at home.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1698: A dangerous criminal has broken out of the castle dungeons, so we've stepped up security in town.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16a9: ...Oh, excuse me, traveller. That silky hair looks familiar... Have we met somewhere before?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17c8: I'm a wandering ore fanatic. I'll sell you the finest ores I've collected on my travels. Now then...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|191a: If you're not sure where you are, you can always press Y and check the map.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1935: If you're not sure where you are, you can always press Y and check the map.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aba: ...Or maybe I haven't. Or maybe I have.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ad7: ...Or maybe I haven't. Or maybe I have.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ad9: ...Nope, can't remember. Oh well. More importantly, I need to find the captain, and fast...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e74: Hey, did you know? Sir Hendrik's horse is super strong and super fast!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e7f: I'm getting sleepy... Time for bed. If I don't get lots of sleep, I'll never be big like Sir Hendrik.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ee9: Hee hee! When I grow up, I'm going to marry Sir Hendrik! Jealous? Hee hee!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ef5: Mmm... Time for bed, I think. Granny says not getting enough sleep is bad for your skin.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f8c: The drink here's addictive! Trust Heliodor to stock only the finest booze!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|226f: To get there from round Cobblestone way, you 'ave to go through that nasty jungle to the south—the Manglegrove.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2284: Whoa! You made it! Erik, mate! An' 'is friend an' all!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|228a: Sorry, I know you came all this way, but there's still soldiers searchin' town for you two.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22a9: Sorry, I know you came all this way, but there's still soldiers searchin' town for you two.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2297: It ain't safe to 'ang about. Come back when fings 'ave cooled down, an' tell me all about yer travels!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|22b6: It ain't safe to 'ang about. Come back when fings 'ave cooled down, an' tell me all about yer travels!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2620: She hasn't eaten anything for ages, so she must be starving! Poor Amelia!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29e7: Luminary {var:1}, you look a little peaky. Too much of the feast, perhaps?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29f1: A stroll to settle your stomach is fine, but do return to the castle once you feel better. Everyone will worry.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aa0: That was a close one. Thank you!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|341c: Phew, today's training was tough... But it's all to protect Heliodor. We must be ready for anything.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|351d: Good day, traveller. Have you seen the town yet? Heliodor is a fine place, isn't it?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3597: Welcome to Heliodor Castle. Do make yourself at home.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3a9d: Your bed awaits in the guest room—up the central stairs, on the west side. Please use it whenever you like.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3f6a: My apologies, Luminary. Beyond here is the nobles' waiting room. I must ask you not to enter.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|40c6: Ah, Luminary. There's only the guards' quarters this way. Please head north to the throne room.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4165: So you're the Luminary... Ah, f-forgive me. His Majesty awaits you.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4620: Please, customer... (cough) If you want to buy somefing, talk to me across the counter... (splutter)
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|46fa: The monsters took one look at me on watch and ran off with their tails between their legs! Gwahahaha!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|471a: Some folk round here can be unkind, but please don't think too badly of them. They're all just struggling to get by.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4767: Zzz... Mmm, Roxy... My darling Roxy...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4832: No need to watch for monsters any more. For a while, I'll just relax and gaze at the sky.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e5f: Cheers! Right, 'ere's the juicy bit... That straw mat just be'ind me? Surprisingly comfy for a kip.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4e69: Trust me, give it a go. Unlike the inn, it won't cost ya a penny. 'Ighly recommended!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4f9a: I'm countin' the minutes till she's on. Aww, I can't wait! Come on, Rox...!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|509a: You've been 'ere before, ain'tcha? Wot d'you keep comin' back for? If you ain't got a reason to stay, I wouldn't bovver.

id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|579e: This is the finest bar in town! We've got a menu for non-drinkers too, so make yourself comfortable.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|57e3: She hasn't eaten anything for ages, so she must be starving! Poor Amelia!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|594e: Did you know you can climb up on the roofs in this town? Look, there's a ladder right there.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5a53: Word is you can see wot's goin' on up on the roofs better on the 2D screen. Dunno wot that means meself...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ab3: Hey, hey! Have you heard about the Luminary and the grudge?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ab8: The grown-ups said the Luminary's got a grudge against the whole world. What's a grudge? Is it like fudge?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5b35: This is the church, traveller. If you wish to pray, please step inside.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5b4d: My cooking's delicious again today, if I say so myself! It must be all the love I put into it.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5b59: A delicious dinner with my beloved husband... What a perfect evening.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5dcc: Oh, a guest? I'm the maid in charge of cleaning. It's such a big house, the cleaning never ends.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5ddc: What a lovely night... If only we could slip away under cover of darkness and leave this town together...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5fbc: Then you'd better head to the castle. Press Y and check the map—it's straight up this road.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5fc9: And if you ever get lost, talk to people with a pink marker on the map, like me.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|5fdb: Welcome to Heliodor, traveller. There's no end of talk about the Darkspawn, but it's a fine country. Enjoy your stay.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|604a: There's nothing over here, you know. This is a back alley, not the main street. Of course there's nothing here.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6060: Copper ore, pickling stones... Even things that look useless come in handy one day, so keep them instead of selling.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|606d: If you're short of money, sell any old Dundrasil coins you have. Selling's all they're good for.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|60bf: So I asked me crystal ball wot to do, an' it said a lad would fetch me somefink called divine dew!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|60ce: Do as the magnificent Mistress Bev says an' good fings'll come your way too. So go an' get me some divine dew!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6171: Hee hee hee hee! Oh, it's you. So, 'ave you found that divine dew for me yet?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61b0: Tell me, mysterious rulers of fate...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61bc: 'Mistress Bev, give the divine dew to the Luminary, or you'll stay skint an' choke on a stale crust o' bread!'
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61cc: ...You wot!? If I don't give you this divine dew, I'm gonna be done in by a loaf o' bread!?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61d7: So that's it... Unless the Luminary saves the world, there ain't no real 'appiness for anyone...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61e6: Tch! Fine, then! The divine dew's yours. 'Ang on, I'll pop it in a bottle for ya.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|61f1: Divine dew's also known as pep pop. It gets ya pepped up an' ready for anyfink. 'Andy in a scrap!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|621b: Divine dew's also known as pep pop. It gets ya pepped up an' ready for anyfink. 'Andy in a scrap!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6203: Now go an' beat the big bad! Then I'll be the fortune-teller 'oo guided the Luminary! Business'll be boomin'!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|622d: Now go an' beat the big bad! Then I'll be the fortune-teller 'oo guided the Luminary! Business'll be boomin'!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6263: Only, they won't let me into the castle. I suppose I'll have to read up on them instead...
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6320: Hendrik the Swordsman, Jasper the Strategist... With Jasper's plans and Hendrik's charge, the army is unbeatable!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6350: Hendrik the Swordsman, Jasper the Strategist... With Jasper's plans and Hendrik's charge, the army is unbeatable!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6332: Well, I'm glad I know that! No wonder the kingdom feels so safe with those two heroes around.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6362: Well, I'm glad I know that! No wonder the kingdom feels so safe with those two heroes around.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|63dc: The world's a big place. They say there's even a monster that rivals the greatest of warriors!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|63eb: Its name is Harmachis! It rules an army of bilhaws on a high plateau in the south of the Hotto Steppe.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|642b: To meet Harmachis, you'll first need to prove your strength on a high plateau in the south of the Hotto Steppe!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6437: He only shows himself to those who've proven themselves by beating a load of his bilhaw minions.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6444: When you've crossed swords with Harmachis and won, come back and tell me! I know you can do it!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|64aa: From what I've found, Harmachis was once a mighty general of the realm of Zwaardsrust.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|64df: From what I've found, Harmachis was once a mighty general of the realm of Zwaardsrust.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|64c3: That despair turned him into a monster. By fighting him with all your might, you've surely let him rest in peace.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|64f8: That despair turned him into a monster. By fighting him with all your might, you've surely let him rest in peace.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|64d0: You did well, young warrior. Take this—you've earned it.
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|65b0: Go an' find the All-Time 'Ide-an'-Seek Master in Octagonia an' learn 'is secret, will ya?
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|661a: The secret of 'ide-an'-seek is 'avin' fun wiv yer mates... The master really knows 'is stuff!
id./param/region/r021.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6637: Right, off you go, mister! If you stand there, they'll find me for sure!
